capabilities: create daily and monthly notes in a fixed YEAR/MONTH/DAY folder structure
backfill notes for previous days and months without existing notes
insert backfill-aware date tokens into templates
open today's, next, or previous daily and monthly notes via commands
add navigation buttons with an auto-journal-navigation code block
extras: The folder structure is intentionally not configurable beyond date formats and root folder; notes must use fixed prefixes like '11 -' and 'MONTH -'. README recommends pairing plugins and shows sorting and template examples.
intentEvidence: The core Daily notes plugin for Obsidian doesn't backfill notes for the days when Obsidian wasn't opened. This plugin does.
problem: Obsidian's core Daily notes plugin does not create notes for days when the app was not opened, leaving gaps in a daily journal.

relations.evidence: Templater: Useful for inserting dates and other properties into your journal entry template.
Reminder Can include a reminder combined with Templater to be notified when a monthly check-in is due
Custom File Explorer sorting Since the default names of each journal are the full names of the months

summary: Journaling plugin that creates daily and monthly notes in a fixed YEAR/MONTH/DAY folder structure and backfills notes for days Obsidian wasn't opened.
